title: Windows app v2.10.2: recent joins no longer listed in the tray
items: The tray menu no longer lists recent joins (the raw links cluttered it) and the Remove a recent server submenu is gone with it. History still powers Prev Server and the paste-box dropdown, and Clear history stays in the tray as a one-click wipe.

title: Windows app v2.10.1: join/extract hotkeys need Ctrl, force quit has no hotkey
items: The join and extract hotkeys now default to Ctrl+Insert and Ctrl+Delete, so a stray plain Insert or Delete press while you are playing can no longer close your game and jump you into another server. Existing plain Insert/Delete settings are upgraded once automatically (you can still change the keys in Settings).
Force quit Roblox no longer has a hotkey - it is only the Settings button and the tray menu item now, so it can never fire by accident.

title: Windows app v2.10.0: force quit Roblox
items: New force quit: close Roblox straight from the joiner - a button in Settings, a tray menu item, or the global hotkeys Ctrl+Insert / Ctrl+Delete.
The hotkeys need Ctrl on purpose, so an accidental plain Insert or Delete press can never quit you out of a game.
The live server window updates right away after a force quit.

title: Private server game links fixed (app v2.9.14 + site)
items: Links like roblox.com/games/<id>/Game-Name?privateServerLinkCode=... now join correctly everywhere: the app and the site keep the place id and build roblox://placeId=<id>&linkCode=<code> instead of dropping the game and falling back to the share-links navigation.
The invite page's web button now opens the real game URL with the privateServerLinkCode instead of a share link, and the menu keeps the place id when you paste a private-server game link.

title: Windows app v2.9.13: rock-solid in-game detection + latency removed
items: The live server window only counts you as in a game when the Roblox player process is running AND the game log updated within the last 12 seconds - the log goes silent the moment you leave, which is why it used to claim you were in a server you had already left. The status says whether Roblox is at its menu or closed.
Removed the Latency row and its TCP measurement.

title: Windows app v2.9.12: longer latency timeout
items: The live window's latency measurement now waits up to 3 seconds for the connection. (Latency was removed entirely in v2.9.13.)

title: Windows app v2.9.11: find your server in huge games (search-until-found)
items: The live server window now searches Roblox server pages until it finds your exact server (up to 10 pages) instead of always reading six - and it stops the moment it finds you, which also keeps request counts down for popular games. When a game is so big that Roblox simply does not publish your server, the count reads beyond Roblox's list while region and latency keep working from the log.

title: Windows app v2.9.10: live stats clear when you leave the game
items: The live server window no longer shows a server you already left: the Roblox player process only runs while you are actually in a game, so when it is gone the window says Not in a game right now and forgets the stale server. (The log keeps its last join line forever, which is why it used to stick.)

title: Windows app v2.9.9: live stats survive server-list rate limits
items: Fixed live stats failing entirely when a later server page got rate limited: the fetch now keeps the servers it already found, waits and retries the failed page once, and is gentler between pages, so big games work much more reliably.

title: Windows app v2.9.8: bigger close button
items: The live server window now uses a normal window frame with a bigger close (X) and a minimize button.

title: Windows app v2.9.7: live stats work for big games
items: Fixed the live server window showing not listed for popular games: it only ever fetched the first 100 servers, so your server was invisible in games with hundreds. It now follows Roblox's pagination and covers up to 600 servers, so it finds you in big games too.
This also makes the server browser and Join Emptiest see more servers for those games.

title: App v2.9.6 trim + site arctic-to-roblox converter
items: Live server stats: removed the Scan Roblox logs button (Refresh finds the server from the log on its own) and the Copy arctic link button (the site invite link does the same job, and the site already supports Arctic Joiner). The Debug button now doubles as the scanner.
The website now understands arcticjoiner:// links: paste one into the menu and it is detected like any other link, so you can convert it into a normal share link.
The menu also has a Copy roblox:// button that makes a direct roblox:// deep link that works for normal people without the app.

title: Windows app v2.9.5: copyable join links in live server stats
items: The live server window can now copy a join link for the server you are in: Copy invite link makes a link to the site's /invite page that works for anyone, and Copy arctic link makes an arcticjoiner:// link for other app users.
Also fixed the window's buttons so they no longer overlap the info rows.

title: Windows app v2.9.4: richer live server window, 15s, toggle in main window
items: The live server window now shows more about your server: players, region (via ip-api.com), ping (from Roblox), our own TCP latency to it, FPS, and the server and place ids - refreshed every 15 seconds.
It now finds the server automatically from your Roblox log when it has nothing, and re-reads the log if you hop servers outside the app.
Toggle the window from the main window with the new Live server stats checkbox (the tray menu drives it too).
Note: refresh is not 100 percent - a server with very few players may fall outside Roblox's public list, and private servers are not listed at all.

title: Windows app v2.9.3: live server ids read correctly + cleaner window
items: The live server scan now reads the server id from the right place: the GUID in the log line "! Joining game '<serverGuid>' place <placeId>". The old pattern grabbed digits out of that GUID as the place id, so it matched nonsense.

The live window looks better: the player count is the headline, the game name sits above it, the server id is truncated to fit, and the debug text is now behind a Debug button instead of always being shown.

title: Windows app v2.9.2: live server log scan fixed
items: The live server window's log scan could not read Roblox's log (the game keeps it open), so it found nothing and showed no lines. It now reads with shared access, so it actually sees the log.
The scan also prints the lines that mention join/server/game/place, so the server pattern can be tuned against a real log if the server id is not found.

title: Windows app v2.9.1: live server stats
items: New Live server stats window (tray menu): a small always-on-top window showing the player count of the server you are in, refreshed every 30 seconds.
It knows the server when you joined through the app. If Roblox chose the server itself, Scan Roblox logs finds it from the client log and prints a debug view so the log pattern can be tuned.
Note: it floats above Roblox in windowed/borderless mode; exclusive fullscreen blocks all external windows.

title: Windows app v2.9.0: server browser actually works, watchlist removed
items: The server browser now calls Roblox's API directly instead of going through the flaky roproxy mirror (a desktop app has no browser CORS limits). The mirror is only a fallback now, so the Servers window should list servers reliably.
The server browser also shows the game's name in the window title and can auto-refresh every 30 seconds.
Removed the Watch games feature.
The main window now remembers where you moved it.

title: New home page
items: Visiting the site root now shows a proper Arctic Joiner landing page with every tool and the Windows app, instead of instantly redirecting to the menu.
Every page gained a Home button, and unknown URLs now fall back to the home page.

title: Windows app v2.8.5: fast flags fixed
items: Fast flags no longer write the render/loading debug flags that caused lag and glitches (FFlagDebugDisableLoadingScreen, DFIntLoadingScreenDelay, FFlagRenderDebugCheckThreading2, FFlagDebugGraphicsSkipVramChecks). Only the safe ones remain: splash skip, bootstrapper update check skip, and the telemetry killers.
Revert still removes every flag older versions ever applied, so press Revert fast flags once after updating to clear the bad ones.

Flag files are now read with a strict JSON parser: a minified or hand-edited file can no longer lose its custom flags (like CSG detail distances) when applying or reverting, and unreadable files are left untouched instead of being overwritten.

title: Windows app v2.8.4: window icons and fast-flag path fix
items: The Server Browser and Watch games windows now show the app icon.

Fast flags are now also written to the correct Roblox ClientSettings folder (Roblox reads Roblox/ClientSettings/ClientAppSettings.json, not Roblox/ClientAppSettings.json), and the folder is created when the Roblox install exists.

title: Windows app v2.8.3: layout tidy and extract-key label fix
items: Moved the Clear history button into the Settings panel and put the Servers button to the right of Settings on the main row.
The Change key button now shows the extract key it is currently set to and updates right after you change it, like Change hotkey does.

title: Windows app v2.8.2: removed start-minimized and quick-join
items: Removed the Start minimized option and the quick-join popup with its hotkey and settings; the app keeps the join hotkey, extract key, Prev Server, Clear history, auto-rejoin, server browser, and game watchlist.

title: Windows app v2.8.1: easier history removal, clearer key changes
items: Removed the Next Server button.
Clear history is now a button in the main window, and the tray menu can also remove individual recent servers.
Changing a key now makes it obvious: the window title shows PRESS A KEY NOW while it waits for the new hotkey, extract key, or quick-join key.

title: App v2.8.0 game watchlist + Open in Arctic Joiner everywhere
items: Windows app v2.8.0: new game watchlist - watch games for open slots, get a tray balloon when a slot frees up, and optionally auto-join the emptiest open server (manage it from the Watch games window).
Every site page (Server Browser, Server Hop, Server Watch, User Sniper) now has an Open in Arctic Joiner button that hands the join straight to the desktop app.

title: Windows app v2.7.2 + site /watch, robots, sitemap
items: Windows app v2.7.2: Start minimized option, so the window can start hidden in the tray on launch.
New /watch page: watch a game for open slots, and auto-join the emptiest server the moment a slot frees up.
Added robots.txt and sitemap.xml for search engines, and the changelogs page now shows the current app version.

title: Windows app v2.7.0: server hop, auto-rejoin, quick-join, server browser
items: Next Server (server hop): one click rejoins the same game on a fresh, emptier server.
Auto-rejoin: optionally rejoin your last server automatically if Roblox closes or crashes.
Quick-join popup (Ctrl+Shift+J, customizable): a small popup of recent servers you can join with 1-9 or a click.
Servers button: an in-app server browser with live player counts, Join Selected, and Join Emptiest.

title: New /hop page
items: Added /hop: paste a game and hop into a different public server on demand - pick the emptiest server or let it keep hopping every 30 seconds.

title: Site: favorites, server tools, saved sniper targets
items: Private servers page: favorite any server with the new Favorite button, then use Show only favorites or Favorites first to keep your picks handy. Favorites are saved in your browser.
Server browser: added Join Least Full (jumps into the emptiest server), Copy All Links, and a switch to turn the 30-second auto-refresh on or off.
User Sniper: Keep watching targets are now saved, so you can resume watching after closing or reloading the page.
Every page now has its own icon and description, so links shared in Discord show a proper preview.
Fixed the 404 redirect list (it was missing the server browser and sniper routes) and a broken card on the private servers page.

title: Windows app v2.6.2: install button in settings, pins removed
items: The install button now also appears inside the Froststrap settings panel, so a pending update can be installed while that panel is open.
Removed the pinned games feature.

title: Windows app v2.6.1: clearer Prev Server and tray history control
items: Prev Server now shows what it will rejoin: the button carries the game name and a tooltip shows the game plus server ID, and the status line confirms the target.
The tray menu gained a Clear history action to wipe the recent-join list.

title: Arctic Joiner v2.5.0: sniper repair and mirror reliability
items: Fixed the /snipe page: its inline script contained stray escape sequences that stopped the whole User Sniper from running, so the snipe, Keep watching, and join features now work again.
Windows app v2.5.0: the self-updater now points at the current repository and the in-app version matches version.txt, so update checks no longer loop.
Repointed all site links, download URLs, and the community issue link to the current repository host.
API mirror fallback now checks the HTTP status, so a rate-limited mirror correctly falls through to the backup instead of showing an error payload.
Invite pages now display the real game name (fixed an incorrect casing on the games API field).

title: Server browser, game info, and app quality upgrades
items: Added /servers: paste a game link to see every public server with player counts and one-tap join; auto-refreshes every 30 seconds.
Invite pages now show the real game name instead of just the place ID.
The user sniper gained a Keep watching mode that rescans every 30 seconds until the target is found.
Windows app v2.1.0: single instance with link forwarding, plus a toast notification showing the launched game's name.
Server browser: per-server Copy Invite Link button that shares an exact-server join link, and recent games quick-select.

title: User Sniper page
items: Added /snipe: type a username or user ID (optionally with a game link to scan that game directly) and it finds their exact public server, with a one-tap join and target avatar confirmation.
Removed the user sniper from the Windows app to keep it a lean instant-joiner.

title: games/start links and Windows instant-join app
items: Windows app now auto-fetches updates from GitHub: it checks for new versions on launch and installs them with one click (downloads, rebuilds, and swaps itself).
Added one-line install script for the Windows app that fetches and builds the latest version from GitHub.
Redesigned the menu around a single paste box: paste any link and the best join option is chosen automatically, with an Advanced panel for manual entry.
Fixed paste detection: normal game URLs (place ID in the path) and links pasted without https:// now work.
Added support for Roblox games/start links with placeId and launchData (https://www.roblox.com/games/start?placeId=...&launchData=...).
Pasting a games/start link in the menu now fills the place ID and launch data automatically.
Invite pages now build roblox:// deep links with launch data for instant joins.
Added a Windows desktop app (windows-app) that pastes a link and instantly launches Froststrap with it, no browser needed.

title: Community system and Discord verification
items: Added Discord verification for community private server submissions.
Added review-based community submission flow for private server share links.
Added global changelogs route support.

title: Private servers page improvements
items: Added dedicated /ps page for curated private servers.
Added search, category filtering, and sorting.
Improved menu layout and route handling for GitHub Pages.
